# Mid Suffolk - council briefing

*Auto-generated from council minutes, 27 April 2026 to 21 July 2026*

## What's dominating the agenda

Housing & Planning leads with 543 keyword hits, mainly via Mid Suffolk Council and the Planning Committee, followed by Climate & Environment (310) and Transport & Highways (303), also largely Planning Committee casework. Document volume here (68 documents) is much smaller than for other councils in this sample, reflecting Mid Suffolk's size as a small district and a lighter meeting schedule over the summer.

## Notable decisions

- Cabinet agreed to convert the Stowmarket Shopfront Grant scheme into a district-wide Business Improvement Fund, supporting internal and external works for local businesses (key decision, 16 Jul).
- Cabinet approved funding for redevelopment projects in Stowmarket town centre (key decision, 16 Jul).
- Cabinet approved the July 2026 Community Infrastructure Levy Expenditure Programme, allocating funds to infrastructure projects across the district (key decision, 16 Jul).
- Cabinet endorsed the council's 2024-25 Greenhouse Gas Report, tracking progress towards its net zero commitments (key decision, approved, 9 Jun).
- Cabinet approved enforcement action at the Fisons site (key decision, approved, 9 Jun).
- Cabinet approved covering a £433k shortfall in the 2025-26 budget from the Strategic Reserve (key decision, approved, 9 Jun).

## Worth a closer look

- Cabinet's Q4 performance review flagged that several key performance indicators are running below target (9 Jun). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1487)
- Cabinet disbanded the council's Biodiversity Working Group (9 Jun). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1491)
- The Joint Audit and Standards Committee, shared with Babergh District Council, met to oversee audit and governance arrangements (26 May). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1440166/file)

## Projects on residents' radar

- **Creeting Road "Big Park" play area upgrade, Stowmarket** - Cabinet approved over £143,000 of Community Infrastructure Levy funding to upgrade the play area at Big Park (16 Jul). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1507)
- **Old Fire Station community space, Lockington Road, Stowmarket** - Cabinet backed the Mid Suffolk Voluntary Organisations Forum's redevelopment of the former fire station into a community space and expanded Red Gables facilities, combining a £100,000 Stowmarket Town Centre Gateway Fund grant with a further £100,000 of CIL funding (16 Jul). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1510)
- **John Peel Centre platform lift, Stowmarket** - the council approved £100,000 of CIL funding towards a platform lift and accessibility works at the John Peel Centre, subject to licences from Stowmarket Town Council (16 Jul). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1507)
- **Tostock Village Hall improvements** - Cabinet approved £100,000 of CIL funding towards refurbishing Tostock Village Hall, alongside funding from the parish council and the hall's own reserves (16 Jul). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1507)
- **Needham Market Community Centre solar project** - the council approved CIL funding of nearly £25,000 towards installing solar panels at Needham Market Community Centre (16 Jul). [source](https://baberghmidsuffolk.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=1507)
